Why Do I Keep Getting a Sore Mouth From My Dentures?

Denture soreness is one of the most common concerns amongst denture wearers, and if you have found yourself searching for answers after waking up with a painful or irritated mouth, you are certainly not alone. Many adults in the UK experience recurring discomfort from their dentures, yet often assume it is something they simply have to tolerate. In reality, a persistently **sore mouth from dentures** can signal that something needs attention — whether that is an adjustment to the fit, a change in oral health, or a closer look at the condition of the denture itself.
